18 | Rapid Shatter Repair | 1 target | P | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster acquires complete understanding of any bone damage, including the tools
and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power
to perform the cure.
@@ 2
Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fracture, shatters,
joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is 1 day. Will not work on skull fractures.
@@ 3
Allows caster to repair all the cartilage around one joint. Recovery time is
one day.
@@ 4
As Minor Fracture Repair, except caster can also repair compound fractures.
@@ 5
Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed).
Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Muscle Mastery spell list as
well.
@@ 6
Allows caster to mend one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered areas).
Recovery time is 1-10 days.
@@ 7
Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is
1-10 days.
@@ 8
As Minor Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 9
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3
Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully
functional after 10-100 days.
@@ 10
As Cartilage Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 11
As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 12
As Skull Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 13
Allows caster to transplant a healthy bone. This requires a 1 hour operation.
Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target’s body will
reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is
the bone is from some other similiar race.
@@ 14
Allows caster to repair any 1 broken or shattered bone (even in the skull).
This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days.
@@ 15
As Joint Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.
@@ 17
As Bone Transplant, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours.
@@ 18
As Shatter Repair, except with a recovery time of 1-10 hours.
@@ 20
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells
and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.
@@ 25
Allows caster to regenerate 1 section of cartilage in target’s body. Recovery
time is 1-10 days.
@@ 30
Allows caster to regenerate 1 lost bone. Recovery time is 1-10 days.
@@ 50
Allows caster to regenerate any part (or all) of a skeleton (including
cartilage) in 1-10 days, depending on the severity of the damage.
